findings.title: Primary comparison and metadata have equal visual weight
findings.statement: The primary comparison claim and secondary provenance metadata remain indistinguishable at a squint.

severity.rationale: Readers must scan secondary metadata before locating the main comparison claim.

confidence.basis: Consistent screenshot observation at 25%, normal, and 200% zoom.

findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The type scale exposes one effective emphasis level.

recommendation.action: Use existing type roles to distinguish the primary claim from provenance metadata.
alternatives: Reduce metadata prominence using an existing secondary role.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The primary claim remains identifiable when text is blurred at 25% zoom.

verification_method.procedure: Capture at 25%, normal, and 200% and confirm the declared primary region dominates without reducing contrast.

evidence.exact_observation: Claim and provenance use the same computed size, weight, and contrast role.
